name: brand-assets
body: Brand assets: repo-root `brand/` directory holding hand-authored SVGs recreated from the brand board, following the written mark/wordmark/lockup description in requirements.requirement.brand-identity (implementers cannot see the board image). There are two SVGs: the mark alone, and the horizontal lockup of mark plus lowercase Inter wordmark, with the wordmark outlined to paths. It also holds the mark's PNG exports at 512/128/32/16px, rendered from the mark SVG (palette only `#0F1115`/`#F8F9FA`/`#FF5722`), and `brand/LICENSE` (all rights reserved, Really Knows AI, plus the trademark statement). Referenced only from README.md, package-channel descriptions and an optional GitHub social preview. NOT part of embedded-assets; never go:embed'ed; never referenced from the served page shells; not covered by the root Apache-2.0 LICENSE (see requirements.constraint.brand-not-embedded). implemented-by deferred: `brand/*` files do not exist yet — plan declares them as planned file nodes.
